translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Wer. Zaburi mar yawuot Kora. Kuom jatend wer. Kaluwore gi mahalath leanoth.Maskil

content.text: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, in e Nyasacha ma resa,
aywagora e nyimi odiechiengʼ gotieno.
Mad lamona chop e nyimi;
yie ilok iti ne kwayona.
Nimar chandruok opongʼo chunya
kendo ngimana sudo machiegni gi liel.
Ikwana kaachiel gi joma ridore piny ei bur matut;
achalo ngʼama onge teko.
Ojwangʼa kaachiel gi joma otho,
mana kaka joma onegi monindo e bur,
makoro ok ipar kuomgi kendo,
joma ongʼad kargi oko e ritni.
Iseketa ei bur matut mogik, ei piny mogik,
kama olil ti.
Mirimbi mager ogore kuoma mapek;
isetamo wangʼa gi apaka magi duto. Sela
Isemiyo osiepena mane ni machiegni koda mogik oringa,
kendo isemiyo koro achalonegi mana koko.
Odinna ma ok anyal tony;
wengena ok nen maber nikech kuyo ma an-go.
Aluongi odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ, yaye Jehova Nyasaye;
achikoni lwetena.
Bende itimo honni magi ne joma otho?
Joma otho bende nyalo chier kendo mi paki? Sela
Herani bende inyiso joma ni ei liel; adier,
koso adierani bende yudore e kethruok piny?
Timbeni miwuoro bende ongʼere kama otimo mudhono,
kata timbeni makare e piny ma ilalieno?
Anto aywakni mondo ikonya, yaye Jehova Nyasaye;
lamona chopo e nyimi gokinyi.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye,
angʼo momiyo idaga kendo ipandona wangʼi?
Aseneno chandruok chakre tin-na mi adwa tho;
asewinjo malit nikech thagruok misekelona, kendo chunya oseol.
Mirimbi mager oseywaya;
thagruok mimiya osetieka.
Gilwora ka ataro odiechiengʼ duto;
gisedinona chuth koni gi koni.
Isemaya osiepena gi joherana;
mudho mandiwa ema koro odongʼ machiegni koda kaka osiepna.

footnotes.text: Maskil: en kit wer moro mane Daudi owero
